items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, its most powerful model yet
items.summary: Google has announced the release of Gemini 4 Argon, touting it as their most powerful AI model to date, signaling a significant advancement in their competitive AI offerings.

items.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
items.summary: AI startup Flow Engineering has secured a substantial investment from prominent venture capital firms Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia, pushing its valuation to an impressive $750 million.

items.title: OpenAI's Jev clone could help the frontier lab stop its swarming agents
items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly developing a 'Jev clone' as an internal tool to manage and potentially control the behavior of its increasingly complex and autonomous AI agents.

items.title: Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: New research explores the scaling properties of on-policy distillation within the same model family, providing insights into efficient model training and performance improvements.

items.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
items.summary: OpenAI details its efforts to detect and disrupt a coordinated campaign aimed at illicitly distilling their proprietary AI models, highlighting ongoing security challenges in the AI space.

items.title: Periodic Weak Spots: Phase Sensitivity from Chunked KV-Cache Compression
items.summary: A new paper identifies 'periodic weak spots' in large language models arising from phase sensitivity in chunked KV-cache compression, impacting model stability and performance.

items.title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Researchers propose a novel method for on-policy distillation that extrapolates RL-induced representation residuals, treating the teacher model as a directional guide rather than a fixed target.

items.title: 1 in 5 Packages Your AI Suggests Don't Exist. Attackers Know Which Ones.
items.summary: A report reveals a 'slopsquatting' vulnerability where AI-generated code suggestions for non-existent packages are exploited by attackers, posing a supply chain security risk.

items.title: Helping small businesses put AI to work
items.summary: OpenAI announces new initiatives aimed at making AI tools more accessible and practical for small businesses, fostering broader adoption and innovation.

items.title: Making global data easier to explore
items.summary: Google introduces a new AI-powered platform designed to simplify the exploration and understanding of complex global datasets, enhancing accessibility for researchers and the public.

items.title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: EvoDuet introduces a novel bilevel co-evolutionary system where AI agents simultaneously optimize web searching and task-solving strategies to accelerate scientific discovery.

items.title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
items.summary: Researchers present WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for interactive 3D world auditing using multimodal AI agents, pushing the boundaries of autonomous environment analysis.

items.title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
items.summary: UniEvo-VL proposes a new self-distillation training recipe that enables multimodal models to continuously improve their performance through on-policy learning.

items.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
items.summary: New research explores how AI can learn meta-skills to design better 'harnesses' for other AI agents during test-time, advancing the field of AI for AI (AI4AI).

items.title: I've been a developer for 10 years. AI just showed me I only had one real skill."
items.summary: A veteran developer reflects on how AI's rapid advancements have highlighted a singular, core skill as their most valuable, prompting a re-evaluation of traditional development roles.
